row.evidence: Toggl's SSO is SAML2 on Premium and Enterprise; its advanced SSO settings say automatic user creation 'does not include automatic user removal', and no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: No native SCIM; status unchanged from June. Toggl now sells one unified 'Toggl' product (toggl.com/track/pricing redirects to toggl.com/pricing); Toggl Track remains available for existing users. Premium is now $16/u/mo annual ($24 monthly) on the pricing page vs $18 in June; the knowledge base still says 'Starts at $18'. Starter $9 annual ($12 monthly). SAML SSO on Premium/Enterprise with optional JIT (no removal). Users can be managed through the Track API v9 on every plan, and invited by CSV. No IdP provisioning connector found.

plans.name: Free
plans.price_text: $0, free for a limited number of users (up to 3)

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Knowledge base still says Premium starts at $18 per license per month (see conflicts).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere in Toggl's pricing page, knowledge base, product hub or Track API reference; SSO is SAML only, with optional JIT account creation and no automatic removal.

endpoints.purpose: Apply changes in bulk to users in an organization
Invite a user to the organization
Change the users in a workspace
List groups with user and workspace assignments

rate_limits.text: Per user per organization: Free 30 req/h, Starter 240 req/h, Premium 600 req/h; custom on Enterprise. /me endpoints 30 req/h except Enterprise-only users. Over-limit returns HTTP 402.

limitations.text: API rate quota scales with plan (Free 30, Starter 240, Premium 600 requests per hour per user per organization).

okta.notes: OIN 'Toggl' app covers the Toggl suite; page markup checks SAML and SWA only, no SCIM or provisioning capabilities.

entra.notes: No Toggl tutorial in Microsoft Learn's saas-apps index; Toggl's own guide creates a custom Enterprise Application.

google.notes: Toggl's guide uses a custom SAML app, not a Marketplace app.

onelogin.notes: Toggl's guide uses OneLogin's SAML Custom Connector (Advanced), not a catalogue app.

fallbacks.notes: JIT is optional (off by default), needs the SSO profile linked to a workspace, and never removes users.

The shared SSO article says Toggl Plan SSO needs 'Premium/Business', the Toggl Plan help centre says Business; the unified pricing page lists SSO on Premium.
